01 · The Client & The Evidence

Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding — Global Brand & IP Division

Scout summary
  • 200+ giant pandas — the world's largest conservation & breeding population; ¥55 entry; demand capped at 45K visitors/day (card).
  • Superstar pandas He Hua (花花) and Fu Bao (福宝) make the Base a global celebrity; 442K visitors in 7 days at 2024 Spring Festival.
  • Fame is global, monetization is local: ~5% of footfall is international; no membership, no global store, no English-first content engine.
Org / IP profile
  • Assets: World's largest panda population; a 50-year universal conservation icon; iPhone-era reach via iPanda (~9.5M subs, ~1B views); visa-free inbound; USD 11M runway.
  • Constraints: No product to monetize with; 45K/day capacity ceiling; leased, recallable pandas; a ~12% green-premium ceiling; fragile optics.

05 · The Strategy

Sell the numbered panda where collectors already scroll.

For Kawaii / Blind-Box Collectors, at the drop day and the always-on cam, riding classic-IP provenance + drop culture, we intercept via TikTok + collector creators with a numbered, provenance-backed drop — so collectors own and belong.
For kawaii/collector fans who collect rare cute IP, The Numbered Drop is a collectible membership that ships numbered, globally available panda pieces with provenance. Unlike generic zoo souvenirs, we release a certified, limited series designed to be collected and traded.
Product
Limited, numbered panda collectible drops + a Founding membership
Price
$30/yr Founding; drops $25–60 (under idol clubs ~$40, zoo memberships $50–120)
Place
Direct-to-fan e-commerce (TikTok Shop / Shopify) + partner retail crossover
Promotion
Creator-seeded countdown → drop-day livestream → UGC shelfies
Kawaii / Blind-Box CollectorsPanda-Pilgrim Inbound TravelersSEA Short-Video Superfans

06 · The Pilot Experiment

A 3-month, 2-market test that proves the trajectory

Treatment
Indonesia + US get a creator-seeded numbered drop, a Founding membership, a D2F store, and localized content.
Control / baseline
Held-out: organic live-cam traffic + the existing ¥55 gate (no drop, no membership); plus the prior merch benchmark.
Hypothesis: A creator-seeded numbered drop in 2 markets will move collector sign-ups and drop sell-through above a no-drop baseline.

Measurement: D2F funnel instrumented end to end (view → sign-up → first drop); weekly dashboard; mid-point check at week 6.
